summary: Iteration 2 retest of the 8 reported fixes + regression. Backend: 33 pytest cases (30 existing + 3 new in test_iteration2_fixes.py) -> 32 passed, 1 failed (brute-force lockout still absent). All 8 fixes VERIFIED PASS: (1) PDF proof detection via proofContentType (backend returns application/pdf on /payments/mine, /payments/{id}, /admin/payments/{id}; admin UI renders 'Buka bukti PDF' link), (2) admin reject-reason label sits above textarea (label y+h=447 vs textarea y=455, no overlap, textarea editable), (3) TRIAL_EXPIRED subscription card shows 'Kuota 1 website · Trial berakhir 22 Agustus 2026', (4) maintenance page shows lucide Wrench svg inside 80x80 green badge (no tofu glyph), (5) public hero at 1440x900 has title/subtitle/CTA fully inside the 640px hero band, (6) /login and /register brand panel vertically centered (top gap 188 vs bottom 195), (7) GET /api/owner-access/{slug} now returns TRIAL_EXPIRED on a fresh session with no prior /auth/me, (8) wizard AI failure (mocked 500) redirects to /dashboard/websites/{id} and alerts 'Website berhasil dibuat, tapi AI belum berhasil membuat konten...'. Regression E2E re-verified end to end: register -> trial -> wizard -> real Gemini generate -> publish -> public /site/qa-ai-fail-shop live with products -> Premium 3 + 1 extra website payment with PDF proof upload -> admin approve (quota 4, status ACTIVE, notification) -> second website creation allowed. Found and fixed ONE new CRITICAL frontend regression: PaymentDetail crashed with 'useParams is not defined' (missing import in Subscription.jsx) - white screen for /dashboard/subscription/payment/:pid.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `useParams` used at line 262 but never imported -> ReferenceError, full white-screen crash on /dashboard/subscription/payment/:pid (user could not view their own payment/proof). issues: Hero CTA is a white pill whose label uses the AI-generated accent colour (`.public-hero-inner a{background:#fff;color:var(--acc)}`). server.py is still ~738 lines mixing auth/websites/AI/payments/admin/storage - split into routers.

rca_of_the_issue: New crash RCA: the iteration-1 fix that added proofContentType handling to Subscription.jsx PaymentDetail introduced/left `const { pid } = useParams()` while the file only imported Link and useNavigate from react-router-dom, so rendering /dashboard/subscription/payment/:pid threw ReferenceError and React unmounted the tree (blank page). Fixed by importing useParams; re-tested and the page now loads and correctly renders the 'Buka bukti PDF' link for a PDF proof.
